primary.method: Serial alternating baseline/candidate browser contexts. Cold is the first invocation in a fresh document/isolate after selectors are seeded in a discarded document; warm samples follow three warmups. DOM setup, selector seeding, IPC and profiling are outside timed intervals. Each version captures its own selectors from identical original content; the unchanged-upgrade case removes additive basis evidence. Seeding resets the fixture's scan budget between independent comments (as independent saves do), reusing immutable text to avoid timing fixture generation. Timing is resolver/capture/index work, not whole-page startup. Profiled work/allocation and heap deltas are diagnostic, not latency samples.
primary.startupMethod: Genuine baseline and rebuilt candidate Shareable templates, fresh browser contexts, serial alternating order, at most five samples per version and no warmups. Readiness is navigation-to-runtime-ready (performance.now), including parsing and runtime startup. Selector/context seeding is outside timing and uses each actual runtime. Native saved comments have captured context; legacy-context-medium deliberately omits it. Every loaded root and attached highlight is counted. HTTP(S) requests are denied.
